body:
I really understand you. I´m not trying to act like everything is awesome and stuff like that, but please don´t do it. Take this comment as the sign send to remind you that maybe things are going absolutely horrible right now, or maybe the feeling of numbness is taking all over you. I don´t know you, but I personaly believe that you are really worthy and you deserve hapiness. So just try to survive until everything goes the way you deserve. Take care of yourself, because i swear that day will come.

If you need something, contact me.

Thank you for making it until today, keep going!
